name: Mochatrade
long_description: Mochatrade lets global traders trade top US stocks using perpetual futures. Access all US stocks including TSLA, NVDA, and AAPL, plus pre-IPO companies and commodities, no US brokerage account needed. Money in and out in local currency (UPI in India), with professional-grade execution on the world's most liquid equities. Starting with India (140M+ demat account holders), expanding across other markets. Backed by Coinfund, Coinbase, and Y Combinator.
one_liner: US stock trading, unlocked for the globe
